text: Ibis-6 listens on port 6055; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Tern-5, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Heron-8 is $4650k. Nobody should assume the budget of Heron-8 applies to Tern-5, the budget differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Heron-8, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Godwit-6 is 3650 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Godwit-6 applies to Heron-8, the rate limit differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Godwit-6 was granted a budget of $4050k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Tern-5 reaches its retirement date on August 16, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
Swift-3 runs in the Osaka datacenter, next to its database.
Pages from Tern-5 land on the pager rotation of Kenji Underhill before anyone else. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
